title: On the Record with John D'Agostino ft. Malhar Oza (Partner and COO at Finality Capital Partners)
description:
In our final episode of On the Record Season 1, Malhar Oza of Finality Capital Partners joins John D'Agostino on how the regulatory tone has shifted and what needs to come next.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain

This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.
